consumer_strategy.before_apply: repeat complete maps under same boot+lock; all reads covered, no libinstalls mapping, no drift; exact existing declaration and referenced SA profile prove demand start
consumer_strategy.reload: no preliminary service stop/start; real installation triggers service naturally
consumer_strategy.candidate_loaded: capture actual new mapping/identity during install; disk-only SHA insufficient; install trigger can precede mapped SHA only in this proven-empty branch
consumer_strategy.race_limit: lock is not an OS-wide installer mutex; unexpected install/service activation between repeat and rename aborts admission and requires inspection, never assume lock prevents all system races
consumer_strategy.fallback: live consumer requires source-bound precise service recycle; no foundation restart by default
consumer_strategy.rollback: repeat full maps; if no candidate consumers remain, restore aliases without service action; otherwise require exact bound consumer service reclaim then restore/recheck
